dedupe_keys.name: nemo belize disaster database damage assessment and needs analysis dana and post disaster needs assessment reports for hurricanes and tropical storms

description: This is the public shelf of damage and needs assessments that Belize's National Emergency Management Organization produces after hurricanes and tropical storms. The disaster database page lists eight downloadable reports: damage assessment and needs analysis (DANA) reports for Hurricane Dean, Tropical Storm Arthur in 2008, Tropical Depression 16, Hurricane Richard in 2010 and Hurricane Earl in 2016, the executive summary of the post-disaster needs assessment for Hurricane Lisa in 2023, and the 2024 country audit of comprehensive disaster management. The report titles indicate damage and needs assessments made after each event. All files are free to download from the NEMO website, which also links a storm tracker dashboard. Caveats: these are report documents, not a structured database despite the page title, coverage is only the events listed, the report contents were not opened here, and no licence is stated. Coverage is national. Simulation uses: building damage and service-loss records for past Belize storms to validate hurricane impact models and to plan relief logistics. Related records: the Belize national emergency shelter list (data-nemo-belize-national-emergency-shelter-list) complements these reports.
